note: Unit figures for soft-tissue surgical robots, one row per company per metric per period. Almost nothing here is fetchable: two companies publish an auditable series and the rest have to be read out of filings by hand. Rules, in order of importance. (1) `basis` is REQUIRED and closed to config.UNIT_BASIS, and it records the COMPANY'S OWN counting rule, not ours. Intuitive PLACES systems, including under operating lease and usage-based terms, and does not split them; Edge Medical reports systems 'installed or delivered'; Surgerii's prospectus reports production and sales as two different rows; MedBot reports orders apart from installs. Four companies, four meanings of the word units. Nothing downstream may sum across bases. (2) `geography` is REQUIRED. Procept's quarterly figures are United States only, and a global count circulates that its own release does not contain; stored without a geography that US number would be set against Intuitive's worldwide fleet and understate Procept. (3) `value` must be positive; a zero is a parse failure, not a count. (4) `placement_model` where the company says, because a leased system and a sold system are not the same event. (5) Every row needs a source URL, a publication date, a `last_checked` date and a `caveat` written for a reader. (6) Never delete a superseded figure; add the new one and let the page show the revision.

rows.source_name: Edge Medical interim results announcement for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: installed or delivered 158 units of our surgical robots globally
rows.caveat: This is NOT an installed base in the sense Intuitive uses. It merges machines physically installed and commissioned at an end user with machines merely delivered — including to distributors — so an unknown share of the 158 may be sitting in a channel rather than operating in a hospital. It is cumulative since first commercialisation in December 2022, covers all product lines including the single-port system, and is not a count of hospitals.
rows.curator_notes: Text extracted from the hkexnews PDF with pdftotext -layout; passage at lines 1143-1147 of the extract.

rows.source_name: Edge Medical interim results announcement for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: 58 units of our surgical robots were installed or delivered globally
rows.caveat: Additions in the six months, on the same blended 'installed or delivered' basis. This is NOT a sales figure and NOT an order figure, and it cannot be divided into the period's RMB319.3m revenue to get a price, because the revenue also contains instruments, accessories and service, and because delivered-not-installed units may recognise revenue on a different trigger.

rows.source_name: Edge Medical interim results announcement for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: over 18,300 and 3,300 cases of robot-assisted clinical surgeries in China
rows.caveat: A floor, not an exact count, and CHINA ONLY — overseas procedures are excluded entirely, which matters because two-thirds of the fleet is overseas. Cumulative since commercialisation, so it cannot be annualised. Multi-port system only.

rows.quote: 按合約銷量計 ... 已簽訂了61台核心產品的全球銷售協議
rows.caveat: A SIXTH basis, and it is not the one used in the interim report. 按合約銷量 means contracted sales volume — sales agreements signed, whether or not anything has shipped. Splits 33 China / 28 overseas. Do NOT chain it to the 158 'installed or delivered' figure a year later; they count different events.
rows.curator_notes: Prospectus Chinese version; passage at line 17486 of the pdftotext extract. 61 core = 60 multi-port + 1 single-port; China 33 = 32 MP + 1 SP.

rows.quote: 我們於2024年在中國售出了20台精鋒®多孔腔鏡手術機器人
rows.caveat: Attributed to Frost & Sullivan, not to the company's own books, and it is 'sold in China' — a seventh framing, distinct from both contracted volume and installed-or-delivered. The #1-among-domestic-makers claim rests on the same consultant's peer estimates, which the consultant elsewhere admits it could not fully verify.

rows.quote: 截至2025年6月30日止六個月簽訂了31台 ... 銷售協議
rows.caveat: Sales agreements signed in the half, multi-port only. NOT deliveries and NOT revenue events. Half-year 2025 revenue was RMB149.4m, which cannot be divided by 31 for a price because contracted units need not have shipped.

rows.quote: 截至最後可行日期，我們已售出一台精鋒®支氣管鏡機器人
rows.caveat: ENDOLUMINAL, not laparoscopic — this is the Ion/Monarch class and should be kept in its own bucket. One unit, commercialised in China from September 2025. The company nonetheless built 20 units a year of design capacity for it and plans 35 in the new plant.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot annual results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2025 (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: Toumai has received over 220 commercial orders worldwide
rows.caveat: A floor ('over 220'), cumulative, and an ORDER count — not revenue, not installations, and with no disclosed cancellation or lapse rate. Stated 'as at the date of this announcement', so it is a March 2026 figure sitting inside a FY2025 results document, not a 31 December 2025 balance.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot annual results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2025 (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: commercial installations of more than 140 units
rows.caveat: A floor, cumulative, and a SECOND running total that the company never reconciles to the 220 orders or to revenue. The 80-unit gap between orders and installations is undelivered backlog on the company's own framing, but MedBot does not label it as such or give its age.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot annual results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2025 (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: newly adding the commercial installations of 80 units
rows.caveat: New commercial installations during FY2025 only. NOT the same as units sold or revenue recognised — MedBot separately states that installations carry customer-signed acceptance reports and that revenue was recognised on them, but it does not say all 80 were revenue events within FY2025.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot voluntary announcement — Toumai commercial installations exceeding 100 units worldwide (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: over 160 commercial orders worldwide, including nearly 120 new orders secured this year
rows.caveat: Based on the company's own 'preliminary internal statistics', a caveat MedBot itself attaches, and the announcement warns shareholders to exercise caution. Nearly 120 of the 160 were signed in 2025 alone, so the book is young and largely untested by delivery.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot voluntary announcement — Toumai commercial installations exceeding 100 units worldwide (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: All 100 installations have obtained installation and acceptance reports signed by the customers
rows.caveat: This is the ONE Chinese soft-tissue unit figure with a stated evidentiary standard — customer-signed acceptance reports, with revenue recognised. That makes it stricter than Edge's 'installed or delivered'. It is still a floor ('exceeded 100') and still self-reported preliminary internal statistics.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot voluntary announcement — Toumai commercial orders exceeding 200 units worldwide (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: over 200 commercial orders worldwide ... installations of approximately 130 units
rows.caveat: Floors again, and note the pace claim implied: +40 orders and +30 installations in the seven weeks since the 24 December announcement. Same-day installation figure was approximately 130. None of these milestone announcements is audited.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot voluntary announcement — Toumai has received over 300 commercial orders worldwide (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: over 300 commercial orders worldwide
rows.caveat: Based on 'preliminary internal statistical data' per the announcement itself. The headline that the third hundred orders took 'just over 120 days' against nearly 1,000 days for the first hundred is the company's own framing, not an audited series. Group-wide orders across all three lines were stated as almost 400 the same day.

rows.source_name: MicroPort MedBot voluntary announcement — Toumai commercial installations exceeding 200 units worldwide (HKEXnews)
rows.quote: completing its 200th commercial installation worldwide
rows.caveat: Toumai only, acceptance-report basis, at HM Hospitales in Spain. This doubled the installed base in roughly six months. It sits against 300+ orders, so backlog widened rather than closed. Announced two months before the interim results were due and then not followed by any published interim accounts.

rows.source_name: Beijing Surgerii Robotics STAR Market IPO prospectus 招股说明书（申报稿）(SSE)
rows.caveat: UNITS BUILT, not sold and not installed. This is the only Chinese soft-tissue robot maker that reports production as a regulated line item, because STAR Market rules require it. Production fell from 25 in 2024 to 23 in 2025 even as sales rose from 2 to 11 — the company says it adjusts production dynamically to order flow.
rows.curator_notes: Table at line 9296 of the pdftotext extract; series 2025/2024/2023 = 23/25/12.

rows.source_name: Beijing Surgerii Robotics STAR Market IPO prospectus 招股说明书（申报稿）(SSE)
rows.caveat: SALES EXCLUDING PLACEMENTS. The prospectus footnote states that two further machines are NOT counted in 销量: one sold to 北京水木东方医用机器人技术创新中心 was booked as an asset-disposal gain, and one at 北京市海淀医院 is billed per procedure. So the number of Surgerii robots standing in hospitals is at least 13, not 11. Also note some units built go to exhibitions and commercial trials.

rows.source_name: Beijing Surgerii Robotics STAR Market IPO prospectus 招股说明书（申报稿）(SSE)
rows.caveat: Two units sold in the whole of 2024 against 25 built — a 产销率 (sell-through) of 8.00%. 2023 sales were nil despite 12 units built. The core product SR-ENS-600 had been NMPA-approved since June 2023, so this is the true commercialisation ramp, unsmoothed by order-book language.

rows.source_name: Beijing Surgerii Robotics STAR Market IPO prospectus 招股说明书（申报稿）(SSE)
rows.quote: 已在临床完成手术逾3,500例
rows.caveat: A floor, cumulative since first clinical use, covering urology, gynaecology, general surgery, thoracic and paediatric surgery. It includes cases done on trial and placed machines, so it is NOT divisible by the 11 sold units to get utilisation per system.

rows.source_name: Harbin Sagebot STAR Market IPO prospectus 招股说明书（注册稿）(SSE)
rows.quote: 2023年一季度实现了两台销售 ... 完成了装机验收
rows.caveat: The company's first ever robot sales, reviewed by KPMG but not audited. Q1 2023 revenue was RMB8.44m, implying roughly RMB4.2m per unit, but that is DERIVED and the revenue line may contain other items. This is the newest free unit figure for Sagebot — its IPO has sat at the registration stage since 2023-06-25 and no later free filing exists.

rows.source_name: Edge Medical IPO prospectus, Industry Overview, Frost & Sullivan and literature research (HKEXnews)
rows.caveat: Cumulative global da Vinci installs at end-2024 per the consultant's table. The US$858.8m revenue figure in the same cell is NOT Intuitive's total revenue — Intuitive's group revenue is several times that — so it must be a systems-only line. Ex-factory price in the same table is given as a wide US$0.5m-2.5m band. Scale marker: 9,629 against Edge's 158 and Toumai's 200.

rows.source_name: Edge Medical IPO prospectus, Industry Overview competitive table, Frost & Sullivan (HKEXnews)
rows.caveat: Consultant estimate for a PRIVATE company, not a filing, so it carries no audit. Only 23 new installs in 2024 on a 186 cumulative base. The same table gives Medtronic Hugo '70+' cumulative with new installs marked 不適用, and leaves Asensus Senhance blank entirely — the Western challengers are thinly covered, and the Chinese players have now passed most of them on unit count.
